connection_condition: tab01.fld002 corresponds to tab05.fld002; the district recorded on the account is the district where the account is held or was opened.
description: An account is associated with one district through the account's own district column. This is the account-side district affiliation and is distinct from the client's residence district.

connection_condition: tab03.fld002 corresponds to tab05.fld002; the district recorded on the client is the client's residence district.
description: A client is associated with one district through the client's own district column. This is the client's residence affiliation, which may differ from the district of the account the client owns.

connection_condition: Linked through tab04: tab04.fld009 corresponds to tab03.fld009 and tab04.fld001 corresponds to tab01.fld001; tab04.fld007 gives the role OWNER or DISPONENT.
description: Clients hold accounts through disposition records. A client can hold more than one account, and an account has exactly one OWNER plus optionally several DISPONENT clients.

connection_condition: tab05.fld013 holds the region of the district described by the same tab05 row.
description: Each district belongs to exactly one of eight regions; the region is an attribute of the district and is the level at which district groups are compared.

connection_condition: tab06.fld001 corresponds to tab01.fld001; a loan row cannot exist without its account.
description: Loans are facilities held on an account: an account can carry zero or more loans, and each loan is a component of exactly one account's portfolio.

connection_condition: tab08.fld001 corresponds to tab01.fld001; a transaction row cannot exist without its account.
description: Transactions are postings that belong to an account: every transaction is a component of the activity of exactly one account.

connection_condition: Both attributes are on the same tab08 transaction row: fld007 is the direction type and fld037 is the operation kind. They are correlated but not interchangeable.
description: Type and operation describe different facets of a transaction. Cash withdrawals appear as operation VYBER, while the direction type for the same rows can be either VYDAJ or VYBER.

connection_condition: Numerator and denominator are both counts of accounts drawn from tab01, optionally joined to other tables to apply the condition.
description: A percentage of accounts is derived as the count of accounts in the reference population that satisfy the condition divided by the count of accounts in that population, expressed as a percentage.

connection_condition: Numerator and denominator are both counts of clients drawn from tab03, optionally joined through tab04 to account attributes.
description: A percentage of clients is derived as the count of clients in the reference population that satisfy the condition divided by the count of clients in that population, expressed as a percentage.
